Class BaleiaCatalogStoreConfig

java.lang.Object
io.baleia.trino.catalogstore.BaleiaCatalogStoreConfig
public class BaleiaCatalogStoreConfig extends Object
Configuration properties for the Baleia Trino Catalog Store plugin.

Bound via Airlift's @Config annotations from etc/catalog-store.properties. The factory selection itself (catalog.store=baleia) lives in etc/config.properties.

All timeout and backoff values are validated by isBackoffConfigurationValid() via Jakarta Bean Validation.
